shows.title: Assassins
shows.description: Everybody gets a shot in Sondheim's Tony Award-winning cult classic.

shows.title: Kohlhaas
shows.description: When a nobleman wrongfully seizes two of Michael Kohlhaas’s horses, he begins a quest for justice that sees him take on the political establishment, with violent and far-reaching consequences.

shows.title: Julie
shows.description: Stumbling into the kitchen on the night of her 21st birthday party, Julie seeks out her father’s employees John and Christine. As one room becomes a battlefield of class and sexual politics, a reckless flirtation becomes a merciless contest sending all three people hurtling towards destruction.

shows.title: Henry V
shows.description: War is coming. Two nations divided by one sea. England’s greatest warrior-king leads his army into battle against seemingly insurmountable odds. Starring Damian Lewis and directed by Rupert Goold, this production challenges what makes a leader a legend.

shows.title: Wake
shows.description: Glitter, beats and banging tunes – this Irish WAKE is the ultimate celebration of life.
